answer: Cross-epoch drift scoring. Each identity has a private quartz seed fixed at creation. Per epoch, derive a task mix from seed plus epoch number and log behavioural features. After a garden of many epochs, require the observed feature vector to stay within a bounded distance of the identity's own seed-conditioned expectation. Violations trigger a reset to provisional status at the epoch summit. Sybils must fabricate consistent histories across all epochs, paying ongoing computation and real interaction cost per identity, not one registration fee.
